sloka: तस्य वीर्यवतो देवि भर्तुस्तव हिते रतः ।अहमेकस्तु संप्राप्तः सुग्रीववचनादिह ।। ५.३५.७५।।।।
transliteration: tasya vīryavato devi bhartustava hite rataḥ ।ahamekastu saṁprāptaḥ sugrīvavacanādiha ।। 5.35.75।।।।

translations.english: "O queen seeking the welfare of your Valiant husband I came here at the behest of Sugriva all alone.
